integrity: The previously known size 26 is not claimed as new. The accepted statement is the unique labeled equality case. Exact independent clique recursions and two channel-ball constructions verify the complete 128-word domain.
scientific_limitations: Only the binary single-grain overwrite channel at length seven and radius one is covered. No statement is made for other lengths, alphabets, multiple errors, or bidirectional overwrites. A hidden historical equality census remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Unique optimal binary length-seven single-grain-error-correcting code
